title: 3D Tilt View DOM layer inspector
blurb: A five-layer web interface lifted into an exploded 3D stack on one WebGL 2 canvas, inspired by Firefox 3D Tilt View and Edge 3D View. Orbit the stack, pull the planes apart, and still click buttons, edit text and toggle filters inside every tilted layer.
question: Can an exploded 3D layer view render each depth level of a live web interface on its own WebGL plane while keeping buttons, inputs and text selection interactive inside the tilted stack?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with five drawable layers, extruded side slabs and per-layer updateElementGeometry() hit regions, plus a 2D isometric fallback.
